text:
kevin: hi all, first week here — trying to wire up secrets for a tiny service `searcher-svc` (dev/stage/prod). who owns the vault path and how do i request KMS wrapping?
anya: welcome! :tada: file a request with the infra secrets form and include the environments + whether you need a new CMK or will use an existing key. infra will create the Vault path and ACLs. link: https://secrets.redwood.internal/new
matt_infra: @kevin quick checklist i always include in the request:

```
service: searcher-svc
owner: kevin (put a team alias if shared)
envs: [dev, stage, prod]
access:
  read: [service, ops]
  write: [service]
kms: needs_new_key: yes
business_justification: customer indexing and storage encryption
rotation_policy_days: 30
```

matt_infra: if you ask for a new CMK for prod include the justification and CI/CD user that will use the key. Prod keys go through a short approvals flow (security + compliance).
kevin: who should be owner? i'm on infra-tools, product also wants visibility.
anya: pick an owner who approves access requests and rotation PRs — you can self-assign initially and add a product alias as co-owner. Owners are the ones who get pings for access escalations.
kevin: any defaults for rotation? 30 vs 90 days?
matt_infra: default for service secrets is 90 days, but for keys or high-risk creds we recommend 30. We can set automatic rotation via our secrets-rotator for API keys; for KMS CMKs we set a key rotation schedule (managed or customer rotation).
kevin: is there a helper to prefill the form so i don't miss fields?
devex-bot: :robot_face: run `/secret-request` to open the pre-filled template; it will also attach a sample policy and create a ticket in #eng-infra for review.
kevin: great. after i submit, how long until the vault path + policies are ready?
matt_infra: typically 4-8 hours for non-prod, 1-2 business days for prod if a new key or extra approvals needed. we'll post the vault path like `secret/data/services/searcher-svc/prod` in the ticket once done.
kevin: last one — emergency access if i get paged at 2am?
anya: oncall flow: call the oncall number and DM @eng-oncall + @matt_infra. for emergency unseal we have limited-personnel escalation, see docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/secrets/after-hours. Note: create an access justification in the ticket for any emergency retrieval.
kevin: thanks everyone. i'll run `/secret-request` and paste the ticket link here so you can quick-review.
matt_infra: happy to review, tag me. also optional: add `rotation_policy_days` to the form if you want to override defaults.
kevin: done, submitted — ticket #INF-4823. linking here for review: https://tickets.redwood/internal/INF-4823
anya: acked, will check permissions shortly :eyes:
matt_infra: looking now, adding product alias as co-owner and scheduling a 30-day rotation on dev/stage, prod will stay 90 until we confirm key audit.
kevin: perfect, thanks all :thumbsup:
